title: 第228章  钟楼伏击
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

黑先生最擅长用亲情、仇恨、责任编网。

可顾沉舟正在一点点学会不被网拖走。

这比修为突破更难。

安置完父骨与母发，顾沉舟开始修补守山台旧阵。

宋青山和沈冰心在一旁协助。

霍景渊带人清理外围，江怀远则安排山路暗哨。

茶会当天，顾沉舟会以守山台为死门侧应点，而非直接站在死门前。

这样既能感应死门气机，又不至于被黑先生第一时间锁死。

顾沉舟用守井符片在祭坛八角各落下一点血。

宋青山则以至阳真气替他补足旧阵缺口。

沈冰心负责压制顾沉舟血气消耗。

配合比之前顺畅许多。

一个时辰后，守山台旧阵终于恢复了三成。

却足以庇护遗骨，并在茶会当天提供预警。

就在最后一道符纹亮起时，远处死门方向忽然传来一阵极低的回响。

众人同时抬头。

第二声。

像地下深处有什么东西敲了一下门。

顾沉舟脸色微变。

“死门有回声。”

宋青山眉心守井印也微微发热。

不是昨夜井心传来的敲门声。

这一次，来自死门方向。

沈冰心看向宋青山。

“要过去？”

宋青山没有立刻回答。

顾沉舟闭目感应，片刻后道：“不是死门开裂。”

“像是井心那边的声音，透过死门传出来。”

宋青山眼神微沉。

也就是说，井下的东西开始熟悉三门通路了。

昨夜它通过井心敲他。

今日，它能让死门产生回声。

若到茶会当天，三门齐动，它恐怕真能借三门投影而出。

顾沉舟低声道：“时间不多了。”

宋青山看向天峰山庄方向。

“茶会布置必须今晚前完成。”

霍景渊立刻道：“我回山庄盯清点。”

江怀远道：“江家那边人员替换也要加快。”

陆沉不在此处。

金石门别院那边，还有金无烈和蒋云天需要看守。

但宋青山知道，陆沉一定也感应到了某些变化。

金石门的金石劲与井下聂天衡牵连太深。

这条线，黑先生不会放松。

众人刚准备下山，江明珠的通讯忽然接入。

她声音很稳，却明显压着一丝紧张。

“宋青山，杏林阁收到一封信。”

宋青山眉头微动。

“黑信？”

“不是。”

江明珠道：“白信。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Mr. Hei is best at weaving a web out of family affection, hatred, and responsibility.

But Gu Chenzhou was learning little by little not to be dragged away by the net.

This is more difficult than a breakthrough in cultivation.

After placing his father's bones and mother's hair, Gu Chenzhou began to repair the old formation at the mountain guard.

Song Qingshan and Shen Bingxin were assisting.

Huo Jingyuan led people to clean up the perimeter, while Jiang Huaiyuan arranged secret sentries on the mountain roads.

On the day of the tea party, Gu Chenzhou would use the Shoushan Terrace as a point beside Death's Door instead of standing directly in front of Death's Door.

In this way, it can not only sense the dead door air movement, but also prevent it from being locked immediately by Mr. Hei.

Gu Chenzhou used the Well Guard Talisman to drop a little blood on each of the eight corners of the altar.

Song Qingshan used Yang Zhenqi to fill the gap in the old formation for him.

Shen Bingxin was responsible for suppressing Gu Chenzhou's blood consumption.

The mix is ​​much smoother than before.

An hour later, the old formation of Shoushantai finally recovered to 30%.

But it was enough to protect the remains and provide early warning on the day of the tea party.

Just when the last rune lit up, a very low echo suddenly came from the direction of the Death Gate in the distance.

Everyone looked up at the same time.

Second sound.

It was like something deep underground knocked on the door.

Gu Chenzhou's face changed slightly.

"Death's door echoes."

The seal between Song Qingshan's brows also felt slightly warm.

It wasn't the knock on the door that came from the center of the well last night.

This time, from the direction of Death's Gate.

Shen Bingxin looked at Song Qingshan.

"Want to go there?"

Song Qingshan did not answer immediately.

Gu Chenzhou closed his eyes and sensed it, and after a moment he said: "It's not that the door of death is cracked."

"It's like the voice from the center of the well, coming out through the door of death."

Song Qingshan's eyes darkened slightly.

In other words, the things underground are becoming familiar with the three-door passage.

Last night it knocked him through the heart of the well.

Today, it can make death's door echo.

If the three doors move together on the day of the tea party, it might really be able to use the three doors to project out.

Gu Chenzhou whispered: "Time is running out."

Song Qingshan looked in the direction of Tianfeng Villa.

"The tea party arrangements must be completed by tonight."

Huo Jingyuan immediately said: "I'll go back to the villa to keep an eye on them."

Jiang Huaiyuan said: "The replacement of personnel in the Jiang family must also be accelerated."

Lu Chen is not here.

Over at Jinshimen Courtyard, there are still Jin Wulie and Jiang Yuntian who need to be guarded.

But Song Qingshan knew that Lu Chen must have sensed some changes.

Jinshi Jin of Jinshimen is deeply involved with Nie Tianheng under the mine.

Mr. Black will not relax on this line.

Just as everyone was about to go down the mountain, Jiang Mingzhu's communication was suddenly connected.

Her voice was steady, but there was obviously a hint of nervousness.

"Song Qingshan, Xinglin Pavilion received a letter."

Song Qingshan's brows moved slightly.

"Black letter?"

"No."

Jiang Mingzhu said: "Baixin."
